name: Gradient w.r.t Source/Detector Geometry
aliases: Cone Beam Geometry Gradient CUDA Kernel
Gradient of Projection Error w.r.t Source and Detector Positions
definition: Computes the gradient of the projection error with respect to source and detector positions. Uses chain rule with derivatives of trilinear interpolation.
summary: It computes the gradient of projection error with respect to source and detector positions, differing from standard back-projection by scattering gradients back to camera parameters rather than the volume.
